entities.summary: Ursuline Church of the Holy Trinity, or briefly Ursuline Church, officially Holy Trinity Church, also Nun Church, is a parish church in Ljubljana, the capital of Slovenia. It is located at Slovene Street, along the western border of Congress Square. It was built between 1718 and 1726 in the Baroque style.
